articles.summary: According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics , prices for food at home increased by 13.5% in the 12 months ending August 2022 – the biggest 12-month increase since 1979. This has left 53% of consumers stressed about rising food prices, as what was previously just a small portion of their monthly budget is increasing rapidly.
articles.title: The Downshift Challenge: How AI Can Help Food & Beverage Companies Fight Back
